metadata.title: The Flood That Proved Levees Alone Couldn't Hold the Mississippi
metadata.description:
1927 Mississippi flood broke in many places and flooded the valley. The cause: a levees-only strategy that confined the river until levees breached.

Failure chain: Levees-only policy → River confined, water rises → Record rain → Levees breach → Huge areas Flood

Related episode: The Man Accused of Breaking a Levee to Strand His Wife — https://youtu.be/WDMBEza0Sd4

Series — Infrastructure Failures: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEtVY8dbosy0

Technical references:
• Wikipedia — Great Mississippi Flood of 1927 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Mississippi_Flood_of_1927
• Government source — greatfloodof1927 (cited by Wikipedia) — https://www.weather.gov/ohx/greatfloodof1927

Narration uses a synthetic voice. Original animation: no archival or stock footage; reconstructions and illustrations are labelled on screen.
